name: AI Image Studio
description: Conversational workspace for generating and iteratively refining AI images and videos with Drupal AI providers, and publishing results to Media.
project_description:
AI Image Studio provides a conversational workspace for generating images and refining them through sequential prompts. Each version remains visible in the session, with provider, model, output settings, processing time, token usage, and reported or estimated cost metadata.

 Features 
 
 Create persistent image-generation sessions and iteratively refine generated images. 
 Select providers and models exposed by Drupal AI, including compatible OpenAI and Grok providers. 
 Control aspect ratio, resolution, and supported image-generation options. 
 Compare version history with readable request and cost feedback. 
 Save a selected result to Drupal Media, requiring alternative text at that point. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configure a compatible image provider through Drupal AI, grant the module permissions, then visit the AI Image Studio session page to create a session and submit the first prompt. Configure module defaults at /admin/config/ai/ai-image-studio .

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires Drupal core 10.3 or 11, Drupal AI, and at least one Drupal AI provider supporting text-to-image generation. Sequential image refinement additionally requires an image-to-image capable provider/model. API usage may incur provider charges.

 Similar projects 
 Unlike one-shot image generators, AI Image Studio focuses on a persistent, chat-like version history for iterative prompt-based refinement, comparison, usage reporting, and eventual Media Library saving.

 Community Documentation 
 Installation and usage documentation is included in the project README.
